description: AVAILABLE AT KEATING CHEVROLET!!!  Meet the 2020 Chevrolet Trax LS, a versatile and practical compact SUV designed to deliver easy maneuverability, everyday comfort, and useful interior space. Finished in Nightfall Gray Metallic with a Jet Black/Light Ash Gray interior, this Trax offers a clean, modern appearance that fits just as well into the city as it does into your daily commute.  Power comes from a 1.4L ECOTEC Turbo 4-cylinder engine producing 138 horsepower and 148 lb-ft of torque, paired with front-wheel drive for confident everyday handling and efficiency. The Ride and Handling suspension, electric power steering, and four-wheel anti-lock brakes help provide a composed and responsive driving experience.  Inside, the Trax LS provides a comfortable and functional cabin with air conditioning, power windows, a tilt-and-telescoping steering column, steering-wheel-mounted audio and phone controls, front reading lights, a rear-window electric defogger, multiple cupholders, convenient cargo storage, and a flat-folding front passenger seat for added versatility. The 3.5-inch Driver Information Center provides important vehicle information, while the rear cargo area includes tie-downs and under-floor storage to help keep everyday items organized.  Technology and connectivity features include a six-speaker audio system, 4G LTE Wi-Fi hotspot capability, and convenient steering-wheel controls for audio and phone functions. The Trax also features a rear vision camera to assist with parking and maneuvering.  Safety is an important part of the Trax LS, with StabiliTrak stability control with traction control, daytime running lamps, a comprehensive airbag system, three-point seat belts throughout the rear seating positions, front seat-belt pretensioners, a tire pressure monitoring system, rear child security door locks, and the LATCH child-seat anchoring system.  On the outside, the Trax features body-color door handles and liftgate trim, power-adjustable folding exterior mirrors, halogen reflector headlamps with automatic on/off operation, intermittent front and rear wipers, solar-absorbing glass, sculpted tail lamps, and 16-inch aluminum wheels wrapped in all-season tires.  The 2020 Chevrolet Trax LS is a smart choice for drivers looking for compact SUV versatility, practical technology, comfortable everyday features, and Chevrolet capability in a maneuverable package. The ParkView rear back-up camera provides clear visibility when reversing, while multiple airbags and a security system offer peace of mind for you and your passengers. description: 2018 TOYOTA TUNDRA SR5 TRD SPORT CREWMAX 4X4  ONE-OWNER ARIZONA TRUCK  $48,028 ORIGINAL MSRP  LOADED WITH FACTORY OPTIONS  ONE OWNER  ARIZONA OWNED SINCE NEW  RUST-FREE  5.7L i-FORCE V8  TRD SPORT  SR5 UPGRADE PACKAGE  TRD SPORT CONVENIENCE PACKAGE  PREMIUM NAVIGATION  METHOD RACE WHEELS  NITTO RIDGE GRAPPLERS  This is not your average SR5 Tundra.  This 2018 Toyota Tundra SR5 TRD Sport CrewMax 4x4 was very well optioned from the factory, carrying an original suggested retail price of $48,028 and approximately $6,763 in factory-added equipment alone.  It combines Toyota's legendary 5.7L i-FORCE V8, CrewMax cab and four-wheel-drive platform with the TRD Sport Package, SR5 Upgrade Package, TRD Sport Convenience Package, Entune Premium Audio with Integrated Navigation and App Suite, factory spray-on bedliner and Deck Rail System.  Add its one-owner Arizona history, extensive dealer maintenance, rust-free Southwest condition and tasteful Method/Nitto upgrades, and this is an exceptionally well-equipped example of the increasingly desirable 5.7L V8 Tundra.  FACTORY POWERTRAIN & 4X4 SYSTEM  At the heart of this truck is Toyota's legendary 5.7-liter i-FORCE DOHC 32-valve V8 with Dual Independent Variable Valve Timing with intelligence (Dual Independent VVT-i).  Factory output is an impressive:  381 horsepower  401 lb-ft of torque  It is backed by Toyota's proven 6-speed Electronically Controlled Automatic Transmission with intelligence (ECT-i) and a traditional part-time four-wheel-drive system with electronically controlled transfer case.  The 5.7L also brings serious truck hardware, including Toyota's factory towing equipment, integrated trailer brake controller, trailer wiring harness and trailer sway control.  This naturally aspirated 5.7L V8 is a huge part of what has made this generation of Tundra so desirable. It's a proven, old-school Toyota V8 platform without the added complexity of a turbocharged engine.  TRD SPORT PACKAGE  $3,130 FACTORY OPTION  The TRD Sport Package is the centerpiece of this truck and was a substantial $3,130 factory option.  This wasn't simply a decal package. Toyota made legitimate chassis, lighting and appearance changes to create the Sport.  The TRD Sport Package included:   	 	Sport-tuned Bilstein shock absorbers 	 	 	TRD front anti-sway bar 	 	 	TRD rear anti-sway bar 	 	 	Sport-tuned suspension 	 	 	20-inch TRD Sport alloy wheels from the factory 	 	 	P275/55R20 sport tires from the factory 	 	 	LED headlights 	 	 	LED fog lights 	 	 	Color-keyed grille surround 	 	 	Color-keyed exterior mirror caps 	 	 	Color-keyed front bumper 	 	 	Color-keyed rear bumper 	 	 	Color-keyed hood scoop 	 	 	TRD Sport bedside graphics 	 	 	TRD Sport floor mats 	 	 	TRD shift knob 	   The suspension equipment is important. The Bilstein dampers and TRD front and rear anti-sway bars were designed to give the Sport a firmer, more controlled feel than a standard SR5, particularly through corners and during directional changes.  Visually, Toyota also eliminated much of the standard SR5 chrome appearance. The body-color bumpers, grille surround, mirrors and hood scoop, combined with the LED lighting, gave the TRD Sport a much cleaner and more aggressive appearance.  This truck retains all of those underlying TRD Sport upgrades while the original 20-inch wheels have been replaced with a better-looking and more purposeful aftermarket setup.  18-INCH METHOD RACE WHEELS + 33-INCH NITTO RIDGE GRAPPLERS  The factory TRD Sport wheels have been upgraded to a set of 18-inch gloss-black Method Race Wheels wrapped in 33x12.50R18 Nitto Ridge Grappler tires.  This is an excellent combination on a Tundra.  The smaller-diameter Method wheel and larger tire sidewall give the truck a much more aggressive stance while retaining everyday drivability. The black Methods also look outstanding against the Super White exterior and TRD Sport body-color treatment.  It's tasteful, functional and doesn't take away from what makes the truck good to begin with.  SR5 UPGRADE PACKAGE  $1,220 FACTORY OPTION  The SR5 Upgrade Package was another major factory option and was actually required in conjunction with the 5.7L TRD Sport configuration.  This package transformed the interior from the more basic SR5 bench-seat arrangement into a much more comfortable and useful setup.  Equipment included:   	 	Front bucket seats 	 	 	Power-adjustable driver's seat 	 	 	Front center console 	 	 	Floor-mounted automatic transmission shifter 	 	 	Tilt and telescoping steering wheel 	 	 	Auto-dimming rearview mirror 	 	 	Anti-theft system 	 	 	38-gallon extended-range fuel tank on the 5.7L configuration 	   That 38-gallon fuel tank is an especially worthwhile option on a 5.7L Tundra. It dramatically increases usable driving range compared with the smaller standard tank and is a great feature for towing, road trips or simply reducing stops at the gas station.  The center-console/bucket-seat configuration also gives this truck a much more upscale and modern interior layout than the basic SR5 configuration.  TRD SPORT CONVENIENCE PACKAGE  $1,000 FACTORY OPTION  Toyota then added the $1,000 TRD Sport Convenience Package, bringing technology normally associated with more expensive trim levels into this SR5 TRD Sport.  That package adds:   	 	Blind Spot Monitor 	 	 	Rear Cross-Traffic Alert 	 	 	Front parking assist sonar 	 	 	Rear parking assist sonar 	   The Blind Spot Monitor helps alert the driver when another vehicle is traveling in an adjacent blind spot.  Rear Cross-Traffic Alert is particularly useful when backing a CrewMax truck out of a parking space, helping identify approaching traffic from either side.  And with a full-size truck of this size, the front and rear parking sonar is a genuinely useful everyday feature.  Together, these options make this considerably better equipped than a standard 2018 SR5.  ENTUNE PREMIUM AUDIO WITH INTEGRATED NAVIGATION & APP SUITE  $525  This truck was also ordered with Toyota's upgraded Entune Premium Audio with Integrated Navigation and App Suite, a $525 factory option.  Rather than the basic SR5 audio system, this added Toyota's upgraded multimedia interface with features including:   	 	7-inch high-resolution touchscreen 	 	 	Integrated GPS navigation 	 	 	Entune App Suite 	 	 	HD Radio 	 	 	SiriusXM capability 	 	 	HD traffic information 	 	 	Weather information 	 	 	Bluetooth hands-free telephone capability 	 	 	Bluetooth wireless audio streaming 	 	 	USB connectivity 	 	 	iPod connectivity and control 	 	 	Advanced voice recognition 	 	 	Siri Eyes Free compatibility 	 	 	Integrated backup-camera display 	   For a 2018 truck, this was a significant technology upgrade and gave the SR5 a much more complete infotainment system without requiring the buyer to step all the way into a Limited or Platinum.  TOYOTA SAFETY SENSE P  STANDARD FROM FACTORY  2018 was an important year for the Tundra because Toyota made Toyota Safety Sense P standard equipment across the lineup.  That gives this truck an impressive suite of factory driver-assistance technology, including:   	 	Pre-Collision System with Pedestrian Detection 	 	 	Forward Collision Warning 	 	 	Automatic emergency braking capability 	 	 	Lane Departure Alert 	 	 	Sway Warning System 	 	 	Dynamic Radar Cruise Control 	 	 	Automatic High Beams 	   Combine Toyota Safety Sense P with the optional Blind Spot Monitor, Rear Cross-Traffic Alert and front/rear parking sonar, and this 2018 truck has a surprisingly comprehensive safety and driver-assistance package.  FACTORY SPRAY-ON BEDLINER  $579  The truck was ordered with Toyota's factory spray-on bedliner, a $579 option.  Unlike a drop-in liner, the spray-in coating follows the contours of the bed and provides additional protection against scratches, dents and everyday cargo use without taking up meaningful bed space.  FACTORY DECK RAIL SYSTEM  $125  Another extremely useful factory option is Toyota's Deck Rail System with four adjustable tie-down cleats.  Rather than limiting cargo tie-down points to fixed locations, Toyota installed rails along the bed that allow the cleats to be repositioned depending on the size and shape of the load.  For someone actually using the Tundra as a truck, it's a simple but extremely practical option.  TRD SPORT EXHAUST TIP  $99  Toyota also equipped the truck with the TRD Sport exhaust tip, completing the factory TRD appearance at the rear of the truck.  CREWMAX CAB  This is the highly desirable CrewMax 5.5-foot-bed configuration, giving you the enormous rear-seat area these Tundras are famous for.  The CrewMax provides legitimate adult-sized rear seating with a tremendous amount of legroom, making this just as usable as a family vehicle or road-trip truck as it is a workhorse.  The CrewMax configuration also includes Toyota's signature power vertical sliding rear window, allowing virtually the entire rear glass to lower rather than simply opening a small center section.  FACTORY TOWING & HEAVY-DUTY EQUIPMENT  The 5.7L Tundra was engineered from the beginning as a legitimate full-size truck.  Factory equipment includes:   	 	Class IV receiver hitch 	 	 	Integrated trailer brake controller 	 	 	Trailer Sway Control 	 	 	Trailer wiring harness 	 	 	4.30 rear axle ratio 	 	 	Heavy-duty 170-amp alternator 	 	 	Heavy-duty battery 	 	 	Automatic limited-slip differential 	 	 	Power-assisted four-wheel disc brakes 	 	 	Solid rear axle with leaf springs 	 	 	Double-wishbone front suspension 	   It is a refreshingly straightforward, heavy-duty mechanical package and a major reason these trucks have developed such a strong reputation for longevity.  ONE-OWNER ARIZONA TRUCK  RUST-FREE  Then there is the history.  This is a ONE-OWNER Tundra that has lived in Arizona its entire life.  That matters enormously on a truck with 200,863 miles.  Instead of spending years exposed to northern winters, road salt and corrosion, this truck has lived its life in the dry Southwest. The result is exactly what we want to see in an older Toyota: a clean, dry, rust-free chassis and undercarriage.  Even more importantly, it has been dealer serviced and maintained from new.  Mileage doesn't scare us on a Toyota with this kind of ownership and maintenance history.  FULLY SERVICED  READY TO GO  Before offering the truck for sale, it went through our service department and was inspected and serviced.  All current maintenance is up to date, a brand-new battery has been installed, and the truck needs absolutely nothing.  It starts immediately, runs strong, shifts properly, drives great and feels like a Tundra that has been cared for.  THE BOTTOM LINE  At 200,863 miles, this isn't the lowest-mile Tundra on the marketand we're not pretending it is.  What it is, however, is the kind of higher-mileage Toyota we actually want to own and sell:  ONE OWNER. ARIZONA SINCE NEW. RUST-FREE. DEALER SERVICED. 5.7L V8. CREWMAX. 4X4. TRD SPORT. SR5 UPGRADE PACKAGE. TRD SPORT CONVENIENCE PACKAGE. PREMIUM NAVIGATION. 38-GALLON TANK. METHOD RACE WHEELS. NITTO RIDGE GRAPPLERS. BAKFLIP G2.  With an original MSRP of $48,028, this truck was very well equipped when new and remains an outstanding configuration today.  Toyota's 5.7L V8 Tundras have become icons for a reason. They're simple, tough, proven and capable of accumulating extraordinary mileage when properly cared for.  This one has already proven itself for 200,000 milesand judging by its history, condition and maintenance, it has plenty of life left in it.  Priced aggressively to sell and ready to go today. description: The 2024 Chevrolet Equinox LS puts connectivity at the center of the driving experience, featuring the Chevrolet Infotainment 3 system with a large, user-friendly touchscreen and seamless integration for both Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. The Equinox LS supports remote access features through Chevrolet connected services, enabling users to control key vehicle functions with their smartphone. Driving the Equinox LS is enhanced by a 1.5L DOHC engine paired with a 6-speed automatic electronic transmission and front-wheel drive, with digital systems managing power delivery and traction for smooth, responsive performance. Electronic stability control and speed-sensing steering further adapt to road conditions, while the trip computer and customizable driver displays keep key information visible in real time. The integration of the SUVs infotainment and drive systems means drivers can switch seamlessly between navigation, entertainment, and vehicle settings without distractions, making every commute or road trip more efficient and enjoyable.  Smart safety is a core feature, with the Equinox leveraging electronic stability control, ABS brakes, and advanced airbag systems to actively monitor and respond to driver and road conditions. The SUVs emergency communication system, enabled through OnStar, uses real-time sensors to detect incidents and summon help if needed. Auto high-beam headlights, tire pressure monitoring, and brake assist enhance daily driving safety by automating responses to changing environments. With cameras and sensors working in tandem, the Equinox helps prevent collisions and keeps occupants secure, especially in urban and suburban environments where quick reactions matter.  A robust suite of features rounds out the Equinox LS, including the LS Convenience Package, premium cloth seat trim, and a 6-speaker audio system that delivers clear, immersive sound. The steering wheel has integrated audio controls for hands-free operation, while remote keyless entry and power windows add everyday convenience. SiriusXM radio, AM/FM options, and the ability to use smartphone apps through the infotainment system ensure that entertainment, navigation, and communication are always accessible. Automatic climate control and heated exterior mirrors further enhance comfort and usability in any season.  When compared to rivals like the Honda CR-V and Toyota RAV4, the Equinox LS stands out with its intuitive Chevrolet Infotainment 3 interface and standard connectivity features that many competitors offer only in higher trims.  Does this SUV have wireless CarPlay or Android Auto? The Equinox LS offers seamless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration, though it is not specified as wireless in this trim. What driver assistance technology is included? Electronic stability control, ABS brakes, auto high-beam headlights, and an emergency communication system are all standard, offering peace of mind. Powered by a 2.5-liter four-cylinder engine producing 187 horsepower at 6000 RPM and 185 lb-ft of torque at 4000 RPM, it delivers smooth performance and impressive fuel efficiency23 mpg in the city and 29 mpg on the highway. Equipped with an automatic transmission and all-wheel drive, the CX-5 ensures confident handling in various driving conditions. This SUV has logged 110,593 miles, reflecting its dependable build and ongoing reliability. Inside, drivers will appreciate features like heated seats, keyless entry, a sunroof, and a premium audio system, complemented by modern conveniences such as Bluetooth, satellite radio, and navigation. The vehicles adaptive cruise control, backup camera, blind spot monitor, collision warning, cross traffic alert, lane keep assist, and push start button enhance safety and driving ease, making it a compelling choice for families and commuters alike.The 2017 Mazda CX-5 Safety and Security FeaturesThis SUV is equipped with essential safety features including 4-wheel ABS and emergency braking preparation to help prevent accidents. Power door locks feature anti-lockout and auto-locking functions, ensuring security when parked or on the move. The electronic parking brake includes an auto-off feature, adding convenience and safety during stops, making the vehicle well-prepared for everyday driving and unexpected situations.The 2017 Mazda CX-5 Entertainment and Technology FeaturesEntertainment and connectivity are prioritized with a 7-inch touch screen display and HD radio, providing clear, accessible control over media. The system includes 10 total speakers delivering quality sound, while voice-operated radio and electronic messaging assistance with read and voice functions keep drivers connected safely. Bluetooth integration allows hands-free phone calls, and internet radio apps like Pandora and Stitcher enhance the listening experience. The vehicle also offers voice-operated commands for radio and messaging, ensuring seamless interaction while on the go.The 2017 Mazda CX-5 Performance FeaturesPerformance is optimized with an on-demand all-wheel-drive system that adapts to changing road conditions, providing stability and traction. This setup ensures confident handling whether navigating city streets or tackling rougher terrain, making the CX-5 a reliable and versatile choice for everyday driving. description: This 2018 Subaru WRX Premium is presented as a standard model with the equipment listed for this trim. The body style carries the familiar WRX appearance, with four doors and proportions that support everyday use. The cabin is arranged for five occupants, and the interior surfaces are finished in a way that suits regular driving rather than unnecessary embellishment. The vehicle is built around Subaru's performance-oriented compact sedan formula, and this example keeps that approach focused on practical equipment and known features.This model includes a sunroof, adding an open-air panel above the front seating area. The cabin also has automatic climate control, which allows temperature settings to be maintained without frequent adjustment. Bluetooth connectivity is included for compatible phone and audio pairing. Power-adjustable front seats are part of the equipment list, giving the driver and front passenger a wider range of seating positions. These items are integrated into the interior without changing the straightforward character of the car.This WRX Premium also comes with a backup camera and cross traffic alert. The rearview image is available when reversing, and the cross traffic alert feature adds another layer of information when backing out of a parking space or driveway. Subaru's all-wheel-drive performance sedan has long been associated with surefooted driving in a variety of conditions, and this example carries that core capability. The chassis, drivetrain, and suspension tuning are intended to support steady control, while the premium trim adds convenience features rather than altering the basic purpose of the vehicle.This 2018 Subaru WRX Premium uses a turbocharged 2.0-liter SUBARU BOXER four-cylinder engine rated at 268 horsepower and 258 pound-feet of torque. A six-speed manual transmission is standard on this trim, and all-wheel drive is included. The WRX Premium rides on 18-inch alloy wheels and carries performance-oriented brakes, along with sport front seats and a leather-wrapped steering wheel. The exterior includes body-color mirrors, integrated turn signal indicators, and dual exhaust outlets. Inside, the instrument panel and center console are arranged around the driver, and the rear seat provides room for passengers or cargo as needed.

Finished in striking Flame Red paint (81U/81Q / paint code U8774) accented by grey lower body striping and bold "Formula 350" door graphics, this Firebird retains its signature factory look complete with pop-up headlights, rear aero spoiler (D81), functional offset cowl-induction hood, and original 16-inch aluminum wheels wrapped in performance rubber (QDZ).  Under the hood sits the top-tier 5.7-liter (350 cu. in.) Tuned Port Injection (TPI) L98 V8 engine (B2L package), delivering 225 horsepower and 330 lb-ft of low-end torque while benefitting from a factory engine oil cooler (KC4). Power is routed through GM's THM 700R4/4L60 four-speed automatic transmission (MD8/MX0)-the mandatory factory setup for the 350 TPI in 1988-and sent to a 3.27 rear differential axle ratio (GW6) with G80 limited-slip Positraction. What elevates this Formula's engineering and handling capabilities is the factory WS6 Special Performance Suspension package, endowing the chassis with high-rate sway bars, precise handling dynamics, and four-wheel power disc brakes (J65) for confident stopping power.  What makes this particular Formula 350 (W66) exceptionally valuable in today's growing classic car market comes down to three major collector pillars: mileage, model rarity, and unmolested originality. While the Trans Am grabbed headlines with heavy lower body cladding, true driving enthusiasts opted for the sleeker, lighter Formula 350 to get maximum V8 performance without the added weight. Because so many of these high-torque 3rd-gen muscle cars were heavily modified, street-raced, or driven into high mileage, finding an uncracked, factory-original specimen with just 12,254 miles is virtually unheard of. Preserved right down to its engine bay tags and door-jamb VIN decals, this bird represents a rising blue-chip 80s collector vehicle.  Inside, the cabin remains in exceptional preserved condition featuring Medium Dark Grey deluxe cloth bucket seats (82B/82I / AR9) that display virtually no wear, complementing a clean dash, factory tilt steering wheel (N33), and original center console. Convenience and luxury options abound, including factory manual air conditioning (C60), AM/FM cassette stereo with graphic equalizer (UX1), electric rear window defogger (C49), power windows (A31), power door locks (AU3), power rear hatch release (A90), power steering, and power brakes.  To view this 1988 Pontiac Firebird Formula 350 in greater detail, including high-definition photos and video, visit www.GatewayClassicCars.com. For pricing, additional information, or to schedule an appointment, contact our Dallas sales team at dallas@gatewayclassiccars.com, or visit our showroom located at 1250 Mustang Drive, Suite 500, Grapevine, TX 76051.

Gateway Classic Cars of Dallas is excited to present this iconic 1988 Land Rover Defender 90, an authentic British off-road legend that embodies rugged capability, timeless styling, and unmistakable character. Finished in an attractive grey exterior with a black soft top, this left-hand-drive Defender is the kind of classic 4x4 that turns heads whether it's cruising downtown, exploring mountain trails, or parked at your favorite cars and coffee. With its legendary boxy silhouette, exposed aluminum body panels, and purposeful stance, the Defender 90 remains one of the most recognizable utility vehicles ever built.  Powering this Defender is the correct-for-the-year 3.5-liter Rover V8 gasoline engine, an all-aluminum overhead-valve V8 that traces its roots back to Buick before being refined by Rover into one of Britain's most beloved powerplants. By 1988, this engine produced approximately 134 horsepower and featured dual SU carburetors, delivering noticeably improved performance over earlier versions while maintaining the smooth, torquey character that made it ideal for both highway cruising and technical off-road driving. Mated to the highly desirable LT85 5-speed manual transmission, this drivetrain provides excellent low-end torque, relaxed highway manners, and the mechanical engagement enthusiasts expect from a classic Land Rover. The lightweight aluminum construction of the Rover V8 also helped keep weight over the front axle down, contributing to the Defender's balanced handling and impressive off-road capability.  Built around Land Rover's legendary permanent four-wheel-drive system, heavy-duty ladder-frame chassis, and locking center differential, the Defender 90 earned its reputation as one of the world's most capable production off-road vehicles. Whether traversing rocky trails, muddy backroads, or sandy beaches, these vehicles have proven themselves everywhere from African safaris to military service and remote expeditions across the globe. Their simple yet durable engineering has made them favorites among adventurers, collectors, and enthusiasts for decades.  Inside, this Defender has been tastefully upgraded with supportive Sparco reclining cloth bucket seats that offer significantly improved comfort while maintaining the truck's rugged personality. A full roll cage adds both safety and an unmistakable expedition-ready appearance, while the black soft top provides the freedom to enjoy open-air driving whenever the weather allows. The left-hand-drive configuration is especially desirable in the United States, making everyday driving more convenient while preserving the authentic character of this classic British icon.  Over the past several years, classic Defender 90s have become some of the most sought-after vintage SUVs on the collector market. Their unmistakable styling, legendary durability, worldwide reputation, and limited availability continue to drive strong demand among enthusiasts. Unlike today's electronically assisted SUVs, the Defender delivers a raw, analog driving experience that connects the driver directly to the vehicle and the terrain beneath it.  Whether you're searching for a weekend adventure machine, a unique collectible, or one of the most capable classic 4x4s ever produced, this 1988 Land Rover Defender 90 offers an exceptional opportunity. Featuring its correct 3.5-liter Rover V8, desirable 5-speed manual transmission, left-hand-drive configuration, Sparco reclining seats, full roll cage, and classic soft top, this Defender is ready for its next adventure while standing as a true icon of British automotive engineering.  For more information or to schedule a viewing, contact Gateway Classic Cars of Dallas today Dallas@GatewayClassicCars.com.

TITLE HISTORY  PLEASE READ THIS FIRSTThis vehicle has a Not Actual Mileage (NAM) branded title. A Florida NOT ACTUAL MILEAGE title was issued on 08/17/2026. Under the Federal Odometer Act, that brand applies when a seller certifies the odometer reading does not reflect the vehicle's true mileage  because the odometer was tampered with, broken, or replaced, or because the actual mileage is unknown. CARFAX states plainly that mileage reported after that point is potentially unreliable, and that this vehicle does not qualify for its Buyback Guarantee.What this means in plain terms: the 52,398 miles on the dash is an indicated reading, not a certified one. CARFAX doesn't report actual costs, so this is our estimate, labeled as one.? The original owner's manual books are with the vehicle.??
